name: OS Client Certs -- decrypt & re-encrypt S/MIME forward
description: When forwarding an S/MIME encrypted message, automatically decrypt the original, replace the raw smime.p7m blob with the decrypted content and attachments, and re-enable S/MIME encryption for the new recipients. Requires identity with S/MIME signing/encryption certificates. v0.3.6 (TEST): for an embedded message/rfc822 S/MIME container the forward is redirected into a reply (recipients cleared, Re: -> Fwd:); standalone files are extracted in the parent scope by streaming the RAW message and running Thunderbird's own MimeTreeDecrypter (which, unlike the messages API with decodeSubMessages:false, descends into the embedded S/MIME) then re-parsing the decrypted MIME and reading each attachment body, and re-attached to the compose window.
